meta.rationale: A sunset that never ends over a grid that never stops moving: your apps are the signs along the road.
meta.theme-about: synthwave drive: a full-screen animated canvas of a striped setting sun, purple mountains and a glowing perspective grid racing towards you; the apps are a row of neon words floating over the horizon, a chrome italic clock above, hot-pink framed windows. Retro, loud, moving. (#road, #signs, #chrome)

desktop.canvas: function draw(w, h, t) local hz = h * 0.58 g.gradient(0, 0, w, hz, "#12002a", "#ff3d8b") local cx, cy, r = w / 2, hz - h * 0.02, h * 0.22 for i = 0, 39 do local y0 = cy - r + i * r / 20 if y0 >= hz then break end local mid = y0 + r / 40 - cy local half = math.sqrt(math.max(0, r * r - mid * mid)) local gap = i > 18 and (i - 18) * 0.35 or 0 local k = i / 40 local col = string.format("#ff%02x%02x", math.floor(0xe3 - k * 0x90), math.floor(0x5a + k * 0x30)) g.rect(cx - half, y0 + gap, half * 2, r / 20 - gap * 2 + 0.6, col) end local m1 = {0, hz} for i = 0, 16 do local x = i * w / 16 m1[#m1 + 1] = x m1[#m1 + 1] = hz - (math.sin(i * 1.7) * 0.5 + 0.7) * h * 0.09 - (i % 3) * 12 end m1[#m1 + 1] = w m1[#m1 + 1] = hz g.poly(m1, "#3a0a5e") g.gradient(0, hz, w, h - hz, "#14002e", "#05000f") for i = -20, 20 do g.line(cx + i * 22, hz, cx + i * w * 0.16, h, "rgba(255,43,214,0.8)", 1.5) end local s = (t * 0.6) % 1 for k = 0, 14 do local z = (k + 1 - s) local y = hz + (h - hz) * (1 / (z * 0.55 + 0.45) - 0.0) * 0.55 - 20 if y > hz and y < h then g.line(0, y, w, y, "rgba(25,230,255,0.75)", 1.5) end end g.glow(cx, hz, w * 0.4, "rgba(255,43,214,0.18)") end
